Antecedentes Clínicos:
Condropatia patelar
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía superficial rotuliana difusa.
No hay signos de derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa

Na učinjenim MR presjecima nalaze se areali hondromalacije četvrtog stupnja lateralne fasete
patele. Rubno vidljiva denudacija hrskavice medijalne fasete patele.
Hondromalacija drugog stupnja trohlearne hrskavice i kondilarne hrskavice.
Hondromalacija prvog stupnja tibijalne hrskavice.
Održani su križni ligamenti. Prednji križni ligament blaže degenerativno promijenjen na hvatištu
za tibiju.
Uz tibijalno hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta formirane su intraosealne ganglion ciste do 5
mm. Osteofit posteriornog dijela tibije uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Medijalni menisk je blaže degenerativno promijenjen, bez evidentne rupture.
Lateralni menisk je blaže degenerativno promijenjen, vidljiva je parcijalna kosa ruptura u
području stražnjeg korijena meniska.
Kolateralni ligamenti su održani. Blaže entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog
kolateralnog ligamenta uz nekoliko ispada signala koji mogu odgovarati sitnim kalcifikatima.
Primjeren prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i tetive m. popliteusa te tetive m. biceps femoris.
Primjeren prikaz tetiva pes anserinus.
Ne nalazi se formirane Baker ciste. Nekoliko manjih ganglion cisti u posteriornoj zglobnoj čahuri.
Blaže entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa.
Primjeren je prikaz ligamenta patele.
Bez signifikantnog izljeva u zglob.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal high grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness) with intact3 cm subchondral bone cyst at the medial trochlea (about intact8* intact8 cm). The patellar cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. There is small focal partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament (about intact6* intact6 cm).  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal amount of right knee effusion is present. There is thin cord medial patellar synovial plica (about 1.8 mm thickness). The surrounding musculature is normal.   Focal high grade chondrosis  with intact3 cm subchondral bone cyst at the medial trochlea (about intact8* intact8 cm). 
  Focal partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament (about intact6* intact6 cm).  
  Minimal amount of right knee effusion. 
  Thin cord medial patellar synovial plica (about 1.8 mm thickness).

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain. [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Focal osteochondral injury at the medial tibial plateau near the medial joint line with adjacent confluent bone marrow edema. No focal osseous lesion. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Small leaking Baker's cyst with internal calcific body. Multiple intra-articular bodies, including a 1.1 cm ossific body at the anterior joint recess and a 0.8 cm ossific body at the posterior joint recess. Post arthroscopy scarring of Hoffa's fat pad.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Diffuse complex degenerative tear of the medial meniscus, with maceration and complete radial tear at the posterior horn-posterior root junction. Posterior medial displacement of a meniscal flap in the region of the posterior root. Severe meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with confluent regions of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with areas of high-grade fissuring at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Confluent full-thickness articular cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet and lateral trochlea. Articular surface remodeling at the lateral patellar facet. High-grade articular cartilage loss at the medial trochlea and medial facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Scarring.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon. Fragmentation of the tibial tubercle, reflecting the chronic sequela of remote Osgood-Schlatter disease.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Lateral patellar tilt and translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 18 mm, borderline elevated.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Small subchondral insufficiency fracture at the medial tibial plateau near the medial joint line with associated confluent bone marrow edema. No significant articular surface depression.
2.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, worst at the patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartments, where it is severe. Small knee joint effusion with multiple ossific intra-articular bodies measuring up to 1.1 cm. Small leaking Baker's cyst.
3.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with dominant radial tear at the posterior horn-posterior root junction. Displacement of a meniscal flap to the posteromedial joint recess.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Falling injury with pain along the anterolateral aspect of the right knee.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Bone marrow edema at the anterior lateral tibial plateau, compatible with osseous contusion. No fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 9 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

Osseous contusion at the anterior lateral tibial plateau without fracture.

МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив.  Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Липсват зони на костномозъчен едем. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 стадий под формата на хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход достигаща до артикулиращата повърхност на тибията. В задния рог на латералния менискус не се виждат дегенеративни промени или менискални увреди. Предните рога са интактни. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е интактен, със запазена конгруентност. Колатерални лигаменти - б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани. Заключение:  МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3.

Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Geringe Degenerationen mit medial betonter Gelenkspaltverschmälerung sowie oberflächliche Chondropathie im medialen Kompartiment. Tiefergreifende Chondropathie des medialen femoropatellaren Gelenks mit Knorpelglatze der unteren Anteile der medialen Patellafacette (9/14). Allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Regelrechte Konfiguration der Menisken ohne H.a. Rissbildung. Mäßiger Gelenkerguss. Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior hornda grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs hafif ekstrude görünümdedir.Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve horizontal yırtık izlendi.  Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrude görünümdedir. Ön çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı izlendi.  Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde hafif ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur ( grade I sprain ). Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar tendon normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinakulumlar normaldir.  Patellar kıkırdakta bütünlük kaybı , subkondral kemik iliği ödemi ve kistler izlendi (grade IV kondromalazi).Femur interkondiler düzey anteriorda yaklaşık 5x4 mm boyutlarında , patellar kemikte patellofemoral eklem yüzünde yaklaşık 8x4 ve 5x3 mm boyutlarında  osteokondrial defekt ve hafif kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler ve tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde eklem mesafesinde daralma ve kartilajlarda bütünlük kaybı, subkondral kistler, subkondral kemik iliği ödemleri izlenmiştir ( dejeneratif artrit bulguları ).Gastrocnemius medial krusda tendonda sinyal artışı izlendi.Popliteal fossada 40x7 mm boyutlarında baker kisti izlendi.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 4mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküste hacim kaybı anterior posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlendi.Prepatellar cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada hafif sıvı artışı izlendi.Diz -kuriris medialinde cilt altı varisler izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma ekleme komşu tibia medial platoda subkondral alanda 18x8 mm 'ye ulaşan kist , kemik iliği ödemi izlendi Bu seviyede femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda bütünlük kaybı izlendi.Kemik yapı köşelerinde milimetrik osteofitik sivrileşme eşlik etmektedir.SONUÇ: Gonartroz, medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon , volüm kaybı ve grade III meniskopati, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain, prepatellar cilt altı ödem, kurural düzeyde cilt altı varisler.
